svg.title: A useful job
svg.desc: Page 3: A useful job. Elena and Jonah plan the replacement pickup, with Ebro visible outside. The waiting water delivery is tied to restoring production, not a life-support deadline. A small joke about a borrowed mug closes the business exchange.
